$comment: Lighthouse CI config for the deployed replica.
`lhci autorun` runs against three URLs, 3 runs each, desktop preset.
Median of the three runs is what assertions check against.
Threshold philosophy: most audits at `warn` (yellow but exit 0)
to surface regressions without blocking deploys. ONE `error`-level
assertion is a catastrophic-regression floor — perf score below
0.40 means something is fundamentally broken and the run fails.
Tighten the warn thresholds to error+higher-bar as migration phases
land — see docs/perf-plan.md Day 5 Notes for the schedule.
